articles.text: WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Hǎo jiǔ méi jiàn, nín chū mén le ba?
COMRADE WÁNG: I haven't seen you for a long time. You've been away, I suppose?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Shì a, wǒ yòu dào Guǎngzhōu qu le.
MR. ANDERSON: Yes, I went to Guǎngzhōu again.
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nín wèishénme gāng huílai, yòu qù le ne?
COMRADE WÁNG: Why did you go again when you had just come back?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Yīnwei wǒ yǒu yíge hěn hǎode péngyou cóng Xiānggǎng lái.
MR. ANDERSON: Because I had a very good friend coming from Hong Kong.
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nǐmen dōu qùguo shénme dìfang?
COMRADE WÁNG: What places did you go to?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Nánjīng, Shànghǎi, Hángzhōu, dōu qù le. Hángzhōu zhēn shi piàoliang.
MR. ANDERSON: We went to Nánjīng, Shànghǎi, and Hángzhōu. Hángzhōu is really beautiful.
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Zhèixiē dìfang nǐ dōu qùguo le ba?
COMRADE WÁNG: You've been to all those places, I suppose?
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Méi dōu qùguo. Yǒu jīhui wǒ yào zài qù yícì.
MR. ANDERSON: Not all of them. If I have the chance, I'd like to go again.
